text:
sylvia (procurement): FYI vendor Alpha updated us: H200 tranche PO-80021 now shows 10 units in 'RMA-hold' at origin. Lead time bumped from 21d -> 42d.
kevin (supply-ops): Are these returns or fresh stock? Any test failures?
sylvia (procurement): Vendor says firmware regression flagged during QA on a sample. They quarantined 10 units and held shipment. No customer returns.
alexa (eng-infra): Losing 10 units will reduce our EU dedicated pool throughput ~14%. Can we reassign some US capacity short-term? Cost of cross-region traffic + network egress will matter.
paul (vendor_alpha): Confirmed. We quarantined 10 units due to firmware mismatch in a single lot. We can run expedited validation: $390/unit test + air express + 10% freight. Alternatively offer 6% invoice credit if you accept delayed delivery.
jamal (logistics): If we split the shipment (some expedited, some delayed) we need split AWBs and customs docs. EU customs sometimes flag splits; may add 200-400 per split.
kevin (supply-ops): Need quick economics. Option A: pay expedite for 10 units. Option B: accept credit and wait. What's the expedite total per unit?
paul (vendor_alpha): Rough: $390 test + est freight delta $110 (10%) => ~$500/unit.
alexa (eng-infra): Ballpark infra and SLA exposure cost: ~€33k over 5w given queued batch slowdown and retry traffic. That's ~€3300/unit. So expedite wins.
sylvia (procurement): Vendor willing to waive test fee on first 5 units if we sign an addendum committing to next quarter allocation. Also willing to provide serials and payload logs early.
kevin (supply-ops): Okay. Proposal: accept 5 expedited (waived test fee) + 5 delayed with 6% credit. Jamal to plan DAP EU routing and book courier once serials arrive.
jamal (logistics): I'll need pre-clearance docs and serial manifest before booking. Ops-bot create ticket.
ops-bot: Ticket INF-8721 created: "Vendor Alpha H200 quarantine partial release coordination". Assignees: jamal, kevin, sylvia. Link: https://redwood.internal/tickets/INF-8721
alexa (eng-infra): Also request firmware diffs and test vectors. If patch is config-toggleable we can gate traffic and avoid rollback risk.
paul (vendor_alpha): We'll send serial list + firmware diff + preflight logs EOD.
sylvia (procurement): Next steps: 1) vendor sends docs; 2) Legal to review addendum for waived fees on first 5; 3) Jamal books DAP shipment; 4) Alexa to validate safe deployment flags. I'll loop in finance + legal.
kevin (supply-ops): Please cc legal@vendor-alpha on contract addendum.
paul (vendor_alpha): Will do. Thanks all.
kevin (supply-ops): :thumbsup:
sylvia (procurement): I'll update exec and procurement board after ticket has AWB and addendum.
ops-bot: Reminder scheduled in 72h for INF-8721 follow-up.
